blocks.text: BEIJING – Chinese travel group Trip.com has listed a 5.1 million yuan (P47.6 million) suborbital space tourism package on its platform, marking a direct effort by Western commercial space operators to tap high-net-worth travelers in China. The six-day luxury itinerary, which was revealed in mid-September, is offered through HHtravel, Trip.com’s high-end customized tour subsidiary, in partnership with spaceflight company Virgin Galactic, which is headquartered in the United States. In the package, clients will undergo three days of preflight training at Spaceport America near Las Cruces, New Mexico.
